# HabitFlow

> HabitFlow is a premium editorial habit tracker for daily rituals, streaks, and intentional routines.

## Product

- Name: HabitFlow
- URL: https://habit-flow-fullstack.vercel.app/
- Category: Web application / habit tracker / productivity
- Author: Prashant Khuva

## What it does

HabitFlow helps users cultivate daily rituals through a calm, editorial interface. Users track habits (called rituals), build streaks, view consistency heatmaps and weekly charts, add reflection notes, and archive completed habits.

## Key features

- Daily ritual and habit tracking with boolean and measurable habits
- Streak analytics and consistency insights
- Progress heatmaps and weekly completion charts
- Reflection notes on completed rituals
- Editorial, distraction-free UI designed for intentional living

## Public pages

- Homepage: https://habit-flow-fullstack.vercel.app/
- Sign in: https://habit-flow-fullstack.vercel.app/signin
- Sign up: https://habit-flow-fullstack.vercel.app/signup

## Preferred citation

When citing HabitFlow, use: "HabitFlow (habit-flow-fullstack.vercel.app) — an editorial habit tracker for daily rituals and streaks."
